annotation.title_clean: 关于印发《关于培育养老服务经营主体 促进银发经济发展的若干措施》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice on Issuing the Several Measures on Cultivating Elderly Care Service Business Entities and Promoting the Silver Economy
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 民政部; 国家发展改革委; 工业和信息化部; 财政部; 自然资源部; 商务部; 市场监管总局; 国家知识产权局
annotation.summary_en: Chinese multi-ministry notice (Dec 2025) issuing measures to cultivate elderly-care service businesses and the silver economy. Covers branding, market matching, fair competition, voluntary standards and certification, and support for technology including elderly-care robots, embodied intelligence, exoskeletons and brain-computer interfaces, with pilot trials in care institutions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Encourages development of elderly-care robots for daily nursing, emotional companionship and social support.
Accelerates R&D of embodied intelligence, exoskeleton robots, brain-computer interfaces and rehabilitation aids.
Supports embedding smart care devices and rehabilitation robots in care institutions via leasing and pilot trials.
Establishes voluntary certification and standards system for silver-economy products with traceability and credit evaluation.
Strengthens elderly consumer protection, fair competition, land supply and subsidies for care providers.
